note: The 21 manufacturing industries (NAICS subsectors 311 to 339) as the product describes them: one plain sentence on what each makes. 'name' is the title a plant carries in factories.primary_naics_description and must match shared/industry.ts (a unit check fails otherwise). Loaded into industry_profiles by scripts/build-industry-stats-sql.mjs; a change goes out as a new generated migration.

industries.name: Food Manufacturing
industries.summary: Plants that turn crops, milk and livestock into food: meat, dairy, baked goods, snacks and animal feed.

industries.name: Beverage and Tobacco Product Manufacturing
industries.summary: Bottlers, breweries, wineries and distilleries, and the plants that make cigarettes and other tobacco products.

industries.name: Textile Mills
industries.summary: Mills that spin fiber into yarn and thread, and weave, knit and finish fabric.

industries.name: Textile Product Mills
industries.summary: Plants that make goods from fabric other than clothing: carpet, linens, canvas, rope and bags.

industries.name: Apparel Manufacturing
industries.summary: Plants that cut and sew clothing, and mills that knit it.

industries.name: Leather and Allied Product Manufacturing
industries.summary: Tanneries, and plants that make footwear, luggage, belts and other leather goods.

industries.name: Wood Product Manufacturing
industries.summary: Sawmills, and plants that make lumber, plywood, trusses, flooring, pallets and manufactured homes.

industries.name: Paper Manufacturing
industries.summary: Mills that make pulp, paper and paperboard, and plants that turn them into boxes, bags and tissue.

industries.name: Printing and Related Support Activities
industries.summary: Plants that print books, labels, packaging, signs and forms, and the shops that prepare and finish the work.

industries.name: Petroleum and Coal Products Manufacturing
industries.summary: Refineries that turn crude oil into fuels, and plants that make asphalt, roofing materials and lubricants.

industries.name: Chemical Manufacturing
industries.summary: Plants that make basic chemicals, plastic resins, fertilizer, medicines, paints, soaps and cosmetics.

industries.name: Plastics and Rubber Products Manufacturing
industries.summary: Plants that mold, extrude and form plastic and rubber into parts, pipe, film, bottles, foam, hoses and tires.

industries.name: Nonmetallic Mineral Product Manufacturing
industries.summary: Plants that make glass, cement, concrete, brick, tile, lime and gypsum products from sand, stone and clay.

industries.name: Primary Metal Manufacturing
industries.summary: Mills, smelters and foundries that make steel, aluminum, copper and other metals, and shape them into plate, bar, pipe, wire and castings.

industries.name: Fabricated Metal Product Manufacturing
industries.summary: Shops and plants that cut, form, weld, machine and coat metal into structural steel, tanks, hardware, tools, valves and precision parts.

industries.name: Machinery Manufacturing
industries.summary: Plants that build machines: farm, construction and oilfield equipment, engines, pumps, compressors, heating and cooling units, and the machinery other factories run on.

industries.name: Computer and Electronic Product Manufacturing
industries.summary: Plants that make semiconductors, circuit boards, computers, communications equipment, and measuring, medical and navigation instruments.

industries.name: Electrical Equipment, Appliance, and Component Manufacturing
industries.summary: Plants that make lighting, household appliances, motors, generators, transformers, switchgear, batteries, wire and cable.

industries.name: Transportation Equipment Manufacturing
industries.summary: Plants that build cars, trucks, trailers, aircraft, spacecraft, rail cars, ships and boats, and the parts that go into them.

industries.name: Furniture and Related Product Manufacturing
industries.summary: Plants that make household and office furniture, kitchen cabinets, mattresses, shelving and store fixtures.

industries.name: Miscellaneous Manufacturing
industries.summary: Plants that make medical devices and supplies, and goods that fit no other industry: jewelry, sporting goods, toys, signs and office supplies.
